title: 機場出包：行李不見、班機取消
subtitle: 12 句英文，冷靜爭取補償

lines.say: Excuse me… my suitcase didn't come out.
lines.zh: 不好意思……我的行李沒有出來。

lines.say: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your baggage tag?
lines.zh: 很遺憾。您有行李條嗎？

lines.say: My… what?
lines.zh: 我的……什麼？

lines.say: I stood at the carousel for forty minutes, watching everyone else's bags come out. Mine was in Amsterdam.
lines.zh: 我在行李轉盤前站了四十分鐘，看著別人的行李一個個出來。我的在阿姆斯特丹。

lines.say: I had no clothes, no charger, and no idea what a baggage tag was.
lines.zh: 我沒有衣服、沒有充電器，也不知道行李條是什麼。

board.cta: 機場出包：行李不見、班機取消・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today: twelve sentences for when travel goes wrong.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天教你旅行出狀況時用的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today: twelve sentences for when travel goes wrong.

lines.say: Lost bags, cancelled flights, and how to ask for what you're owed.
lines.zh: 行李不見、班機取消，還有怎麼爭取你應得的補償。

scenes.title: Lost bag
scenes.sub: 行李不見：報失、描述、追蹤

lines.say: Part one: your bag is lost.
lines.zh: 第一段：行李不見了。

lines.say: First, don't leave the airport. Go straight to the baggage desk.
lines.zh: 第一步，不要離開機場，直接去行李服務台。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: My suitcase hasn't arrived. I'd like to file a report.
scenes.meaning: 我的行李沒有到，我要報遺失
scenes.note: file a report ＝ 正式報告、登記

lines.say: My suitcase hasn't arrived. I'd like to file a report.
File a report means make an official record.
lines.zh: file a report 是正式登記一筆紀錄。

lines.say: Your baggage tag is the sticker with a barcode they gave you at check-in. It's usually on your boarding pass.
lines.zh: 行李條就是報到時給你的條碼貼紙，通常貼在登機證上。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: My suitcase hasn't arrived. I'd like to file a report.

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: It's a large navy suitcase with a yellow ribbon on the handle.
scenes.meaning: 是一個大的深藍色行李箱，把手上綁了黃色緞帶

lines.say: Then describe it. Size, colour, then the special thing.
lines.zh: 接著描述：大小、顏色，再講特別的地方。

lines.say: It's a large navy suitcase with a yellow ribbon on the handle.
Navy is dark blue. A ribbon on the handle is the classic way to find your bag.
lines.zh: navy 是深藍色。把手綁緞帶是最經典的認行李方法。

lines.say: Hundreds of suitcases are navy. Only yours has the ribbon.
lines.zh: 深藍色的行李箱有幾百個，綁緞帶的只有你的。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: It's a large navy suitcase with a yellow ribbon on the handle.

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: Could you have it delivered to my address when it turns up?
scenes.meaning: 找到後可以送到我的住址嗎？
scenes.note: have it delivered ＝ 請人送來　turn up ＝ 出現

lines.say: And ask them to bring it to you. Don't go back for it.
lines.zh: 請他們送過來，不要自己再跑回去。

lines.say: Could you have it delivered to my address when it turns up?
Have it delivered means ask someone to deliver it. You don't do it yourself.
lines.zh: have it delivered 是請人送，不是你自己去拿。

lines.say: Turn up means appear, usually after being lost.
lines.zh: turn up 是失而復得、出現。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Could you have it delivered to my address when it turns up?

scenes.title: Cancelled
scenes.sub: 班機取消：問清楚下一步

lines.say: Part two: your flight is cancelled.
lines.zh: 第二段：班機取消了。

lines.say: The screen says cancelled, and two hundred people run to one desk. Be ready with the right questions.
lines.zh: 螢幕顯示取消，兩百個人衝向同一個櫃台。準備好正確的問題。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: My flight's been cancelled. What are my options?
scenes.meaning: 我的班機取消了，我有哪些選擇？
scenes.note: What are my options? ＝ 我有哪些選擇

lines.say: My flight's been cancelled. What are my options?
What are my options is better than what do I do now. It asks for choices, not orders.
lines.zh: What are my options 比 what do I do now 好，你要的是選項，不是指令。

lines.say: The first option they give is often not the best one. Listen to all of them.
lines.zh: 他們給的第一個選項常常不是最好的，全部聽完。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: My flight's been cancelled. What are my options?

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: Is there an earlier flight I could be rebooked on?
scenes.meaning: 有更早的班機可以幫我改訂嗎？

lines.say: Then ask for the one you want.
lines.zh: 接著主動要你想要的。

lines.say: Is there an earlier flight I could be rebooked on?
Rebook means change your ticket to a new flight.
lines.zh: rebook 是幫你換到另一個航班。

lines.say: Check the airline app while you wait. Sometimes you can find the flight before they do!
lines.zh: 排隊時看一下航空公司 app，有時候你比他們先找到班機！

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Is there an earlier flight I could be rebooked on?

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: If I have to stay overnight, will the airline cover the hotel?
scenes.meaning: 如果要過夜，航空公司會負擔飯店嗎？

lines.say: And if the next flight is tomorrow, ask this.
lines.zh: 如果下一班是明天，問這一句。

lines.say: If I have to stay overnight, will the airline cover the hotel?
Cover means pay for. Overnight means for the night.
lines.zh: cover 是支付，overnight 是過夜。

lines.say: In Europe, the airline must look after you when they cancel. Ask, and keep your receipts.
lines.zh: 在歐洲，航班取消時航空公司有義務照顧你。要問，收據也要留好。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: If I have to stay overnight, will the airline cover the hotel?
Watch how this goes.
lines.zh: 來看看會怎麼發展。

lines.say: My flight's been cancelled. What are my options?
lines.zh: 我的班機取消了，我有哪些選擇？

lines.say: We can put you on tomorrow morning's flight.
lines.zh: 我們可以幫您改到明天早上的班機。

lines.say: Is there an earlier flight I could be rebooked on? There's one tonight with your partner airline.
lines.zh: 有更早的班機可以幫我改訂嗎？你們的合作航空今晚有一班。

lines.say: Let me check. Yes, there are two seats left.
lines.zh: 我查一下。是的，還剩兩個位子。

lines.say: She found it because I asked. Not because she offered.
lines.zh: 是因為我開口問，她才去找的，不是她主動給的。

lines.say: Part three: compensation.
lines.zh: 第三段：爭取補償。

lines.say: In the EU, a long delay or a late cancellation can mean money back. Many people never ask.
lines.zh: 在歐盟，長時間延誤或臨時取消可以拿到賠償。很多人從來不問。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: Am I entitled to any compensation for this?
scenes.meaning: 這種情況我有資格拿到補償嗎？
scenes.note: be entitled to ＝ 有權得到

lines.say: Am I entitled to any compensation for this?
Entitled to means you have the right to it. It's yours by law.
lines.zh: entitled to 是你有權利得到，依法屬於你。

lines.say: It sounds formal and confident. Exactly how you want to sound here.
lines.zh: 聽起來正式又有自信，這時候就是要這種語氣。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Am I entitled to any compensation for this?

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: Could I have that in writing, with the reason for the delay?
scenes.meaning: 可以給我書面說明，包括延誤的原因嗎？

lines.say: Then get proof.
lines.zh: 接著拿證據。

lines.say: Could I have that in writing, with the reason for the delay?
The reason matters. Bad weather usually means no money. A technical problem usually means money.
lines.zh: 原因很重要。天氣不好通常不賠，機械問題通常要賠。

lines.say: With it in writing, nobody can change the story later.
lines.zh: 有書面紀錄，之後誰都改不了說法。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Could I have that in writing, with the reason for the delay?

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: Where do I send my receipts for food and taxis?
scenes.meaning: 餐費和計程車的收據要寄到哪裡？

lines.say: And don't forget the small costs.
lines.zh: 小錢也不要忘了。

lines.say: Where do I send my receipts for food and taxis?
Receipts are the papers that show what you paid.
lines.zh: receipt 是付款的證明。

lines.say: A sandwich, a phone charger, a taxi. It adds up.
lines.zh: 一個三明治、一條充電線、一趟計程車，加起來不少。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Where do I send my receipts for food and taxis?

scenes.title: Stay human
scenes.sub: 保持禮貌：櫃台人員是你的盟友

lines.say: Part four: stay human.
lines.zh: 第四段：保持禮貌。

lines.say: The person at the desk didn't cancel your flight. And they decide how hard they try for you.
lines.zh: 櫃台人員沒有取消你的班機，但他們決定要為你多努力。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: I know it's not your fault. You must be having a crazy day.
scenes.meaning: 我知道不是你的錯，你今天一定忙翻了
scenes.note: You must be ＝ 你一定是……（推測）

lines.say: I know it's not your fault. You must be having a crazy day.
You must be is a guess about someone's situation. Here it shows sympathy.
lines.zh: You must be 是推測對方的狀況，這裡表示同理。

lines.say: After a hundred angry passengers, this sentence feels like a holiday.
lines.zh: 被一百個生氣的乘客罵過之後，聽到這句就像放假。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I know it's not your fault. You must be having a crazy day.

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: Is there anything else you can do for me?
scenes.meaning: 還有其他你能幫我的嗎？

lines.say: Before you leave the desk, one last try.
lines.zh: 離開櫃台前，再爭取一次。

lines.say: Is there anything else you can do for me?
It's an open question. Sometimes the answer is a meal voucher, or lounge access.
lines.zh: 這是開放式問題，有時候會換來餐券或貴賓室。

lines.say: They often have more to give. They just don't offer it first.
lines.zh: 他們常常有更多可以給，只是不會先講。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Is there anything else you can do for me?

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: Thanks so much. You've been a great help.
scenes.note: a great help ＝ 幫了大忙

lines.say: And thank them properly.
lines.zh: 最後好好道謝。

lines.say: Thanks so much. You've been a great help.
You've been a great help means you made a real difference.
lines.zh: You've been a great help 是你真的幫了很多。

lines.say: If they were great, write the airline a short note with their name. It matters.
lines.zh: 如果對方真的很棒，寫封短信給航空公司提他的名字，很有意義。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Thanks so much. You've been a great help.
I know it's not your fault. You must be having a crazy day.
lines.zh: 我知道不是你的錯，你今天一定忙翻了。

lines.say: Ha! You have no idea. Thank you.
lines.zh: 哈！你無法想像。謝謝你。

lines.say: Am I entitled to any compensation for this?
lines.zh: 這種情況我有資格拿到補償嗎？

lines.say: Yes. It was a technical problem, so you can claim online.
lines.zh: 有，這是機械問題，您可以上網申請。

lines.say: Is there anything else you can do for me?
lines.zh: 還有其他你能幫我的嗎？

lines.say: Here's a voucher for dinner. Enjoy.
lines.zh: 這是晚餐券，請享用。

lines.say: A new flight, money back, and free dinner. Kindness works.
lines.zh: 新的班機、拿回賠償，還有晚餐。善意有用。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：旅行時的兩句話

lines.say: One more thing! Two Irish phrases for travel days.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！旅行時會聽到的兩句愛爾蘭話。

lines.say: Telling your Irish friends about the trip? They'll say this.
lines.zh: 跟愛爾蘭朋友講這趟旅程？他們會這樣說。

lines.say: What a nightmare!
Then they'll tell you an even worse travel story. It's a competition here.
lines.zh: 然後他們會講一個更慘的旅行故事。在這裡這是比賽。

lines.say: And when you finally get home, tired, with no suitcase…
lines.zh: 最後終於到家，累到不行，行李還沒到……

lines.say: Ah, home sweet home.
It's not only Irish, but you'll hear it every time someone walks in the door.
lines.zh: 這不只是愛爾蘭說法，但每次有人進家門都會聽到。

lines.say: Home sweet home!

scenes.title: All together
scenes.sub: 總複習：同一個機場，不同的結局

lines.say: Back to the baggage desk one more time. Say my lines with me!
lines.zh: 再回到行李服務台一次。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: My suitcase hasn't arrived. I'd like to file a report.
lines.zh: 我的行李沒有到，我要報遺失。

lines.say: Of course. Can you describe it?
lines.zh: 好的，可以描述一下嗎？

lines.say: It's a large navy suitcase with a yellow ribbon on the handle.
lines.zh: 是一個大的深藍色行李箱，把手上綁了黃色緞帶。

lines.say: Got it. It's in Amsterdam. It will be here tomorrow.
lines.zh: 了解，它在阿姆斯特丹，明天會到。

lines.say: Could you have it delivered to my address when it turns up?
lines.zh: 找到後可以送到我的住址嗎？

lines.say: Absolutely.
lines.zh: 當然可以。

lines.say: Thanks so much. You've been a great help.
lines.zh: 太感謝了，你幫了大忙。

lines.say: Bag found, flight changed, money back. Safe travels!
lines.zh: 行李找到、班機改好、補償拿到。一路順風！

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Screenshot them before your next flight.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡，下次搭飛機前先截圖。

lines.say: Before you go! Do you want to practise English a little every day?
lines.zh: 走之前！想每天都練一點英文嗎？

lines.say: Try BinBin. Every day, there's a short news story from where you live, with the hard words explained.
lines.zh: 試試 BinBin。每天一則你所在地區的短新聞，難的單字都有解釋。

lines.say: Then play quick word games, on your own or with your friends.
lines.zh: 接著玩快速的單字小遊戲，自己玩或約朋友一起。

lines.say: Keep your streak going, unlock new titles, and say hi to other learners in the plaza.
lines.zh: 保持連續打卡、解鎖新稱號，還能在廣場跟其他學習者打招呼。

lines.say: And there are more lessons like this one, right inside the app.
lines.zh: App 裡還有更多像這樣的英文小教室。

lines.zh: 上 binbindaily.com，或點下面的連結。
lines.cap: Go to binbindaily.com, or tap the link below.

lines.say: And now I always pack a charger in my hand luggage. See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 現在我一定把充電器放在隨身行李裡。下一課見，Bye！
